arStrings.szText: "Who are the Midwives trying to birth if it isn't Lilith?"
I don’t know. Nothing good, certainly. The original ritual’s design was for Lilith’s return alone. Without my knowledge, the Midwives are tampering with it blind.
Still, we have a lead now. I’ll meet you in southern Atanos once I’ve gathered my things. I don’t want them near this loon.
